title: 일반동사 과거 (규칙 -ed · 불규칙)
goal: 일반동사의 과거형(-ed와 불규칙 동사)으로 어제, 지난주에 한 일을 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: 과거형은 주어와 상관없이 같아요
points.body: 현재형은 He walks처럼 -s가 붙지만, 과거형은 I walked, He walked, They walked처럼 주어가 누구든 모양이 같아요.

points.title: 규칙 동사: 끝에 -ed
points.body: 대부분의 동사는 끝에 -ed를 붙여요. clean → cleaned, finish → finished, watch → watched, wait → waited. e로 끝나면 -d만 붙여요. live → lived, die → died.

points.title: 모양이 살짝 바뀌는 규칙 동사
points.body: '자음 + y'로 끝나면 y를 i로 바꾸고 -ed: study → studied. plan처럼 '모음 하나 + 자음 하나'로 끝나는 짧은 동사는 마지막 자음을 한 번 더 쓰고 -ed: plan → planned, stop → stopped.

points.title: 불규칙 동사: 통째로 외우기
points.body: -ed를 쓰지 않고 모양이 완전히 바뀌는 동사도 있어요. have → had, get → got, buy → bought, go → went. 자주 쓰는 동사일수록 불규칙이 많으니 하나씩 외워 두세요.

points.title: 과거 시간 표현
points.body: yesterday(어제), last Friday(지난 금요일), last week(지난주), a month ago(한 달 전), this morning(오늘 아침), in 1890(1890년에) 같은 말과 함께 과거형을 써요.

formula: 주어 + 동사 과거형 + ... (모든 주어 같은 모양)
규칙 -ed: clean → cleaned · finish → finished · watch → watched · laugh → laughed · wait → waited
규칙 (모양 주의): live → lived · die → died · study → studied · plan → planned
불규칙: have → had · get → got · buy → bought · go → went

mistakes.wrong: I goed to the beach yesterday.
mistakes.right: I went to the beach yesterday.
mistakes.why: go는 불규칙 동사라 -ed를 붙이지 않아요. go의 과거는 went.
'자음 + y'로 끝나는 동사는 y를 i로 바꾸고 -ed를 붙여요.
한국어는 '어제'만 있어도 과거가 느껴지지만, 영어는 동사를 꼭 과거형으로 바꿔야 해요.

examples.en: I cleaned the house last Friday.
The soccer game finished at 5 o'clock yesterday.
We planned our vacation a month ago.
examples.ko: 우리는 한 달 전에 휴가 계획을 세웠어요.

examples.en: Emily had bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
examples.ko: Emily는 오늘 아침으로 베이컨과 달걀을 먹었어요.

examples.en: "I bought a new sofa last week." "It's really nice."
We went to the beach and watched the sunset.

studyed

quiz.sentence: They ___ for the tram for 30 minutes this morning.
choices: waited
wait
waits
waitted
quiz.ko: 그들은 오늘 아침에 트램을 30분 동안 기다렸어요.
quiz.why: wait + -ed = waited. t를 두 번 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.answer: I worked on a farm yesterday.
choices: I worked on a farm yesterday.
I work on a farm yesterday.
I workd on a farm yesterday.
I was work on a farm yesterday.
quiz.why: work + -ed = worked. 일반동사 과거에는 was를 같이 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.ko: 우리는 한 달 전에 휴가 계획을 세웠어요.
quiz.answer: We planned our vacation a month ago.
choices: We planned our vacation a month ago.
We plan our vacation a month ago.
We planning our vacation a month ago.
We were plan our vacation a month ago.
quiz.why: plan은 n을 한 번 더 쓰고 -ed → planned.

quiz.ko: Emily는 오늘 아침으로 베이컨과 달걀을 먹었어요.
quiz.answer: Emily had bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
choices: Emily had bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
Emily haved bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
Emily have bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
Emily was have bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
quiz.why: have는 불규칙 동사. 과거형은 had. '먹다'라는 뜻으로도 써요.

quiz.answer: He bought a new sofa last week.
choices: He bought a new sofa last week.
He buyed a new sofa last week.
He buy a new sofa last week.
He buys a new sofa last week.
quiz.why: buy의 과거형은 bought. last week가 있으니 과거형을 써요.

quiz.answer: I got a job at a cafe last week.

I getted a job at a cafe last week.
I get a job at a cafe last week.
I was get a job at a cafe last week.

quiz.answer: My housemate lived in Brisbane two years ago.
choices: My housemate lived in Brisbane two years ago.
My housemate liveed in Brisbane two years ago.
My housemate live in Brisbane two years ago.

quiz.answer: He watched a movie and laughed a lot.
choices: He watched a movie and laughed a lot.
He watch a movie and laughed a lot.
He watched a movie and laughd a lot.
He watchd a movie and laughed a lot.
quiz.why: watch → watched, laugh → laughed. 두 동사 모두 과거형으로 -ed를 붙여요.
